description: Open Research Opportunity Miner — Leads with a verdict (OPEN_GAPS_FOUND, NO_CLEAR_OPEN_GAPS or NO_GAPS_EXTRACTED), a confidence, a headline naming the top gap with its quoted evidence, and the next step. Collects papers for a topic or seed list (arXiv ids or URLs, DOIs, PMIDs; arXiv and OpenAlex search), reads full text from ar5iv or Europe PMC, and extracts future-work, limitation and open-question sentences in code with exact se

field.description: Field or discipline keyword added to the topic search, e.g. "machine learning".

fromDate.description: Only topic-search papers published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

maxPapers.description: Papers to analyse, at most 25 (default 10); seeds count toward it.

mode.description: fast: zero model calls (lexical clustering and lexical addressed-check). full (default): one clustering call and one judging call, bounded to one status level.

query.description: Research topic, e.g. "parameter-efficient fine-tuning of language models".

seeds.description: Seed papers you already have: arXiv ids or URLs (2106.09685, arXiv:1706.03762, arxiv.org/abs/...), DOIs or doi.org URLs, or PMIDs (PMID:12345678 or a PubMed URL). Always analysed, not date-filtered.

toDate.description: Only topic-search papers published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: future-work-miner
